newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong up on flats sale hope.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong up on flats sale hope.

text.p: Shares of Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd rose on expectation that the company will offer its latest luxury residential development in Hunghom at a high price, brokers said on Monday.
Cheung Kong shares rose HK$3.00 or 4.05 percent to HK$77.00 in late trade on volume of 5.38 million shares.
"Buying interest was fueled by expectation that the development would be offered at a high price, setting a new indicator to the property market," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
Brokers said anticipation of stronger earnings from sales of the flats boosted buying interest.
"Local investors dominated buying and that implies they were optimistic on the (Hong Kong) property market," Mak said.
Brokers said the market expects Cheung Kong to offer the flats at above HK$8,000 per square foot, a new high for the residential market in the Hunghom area.
Cheung Kong is expected to give details of its sale of the joint development with China Light and Power Group, Laguna Verde, in Hunghom in Kowloon, later this week.
